visualReview.scope: Actual Renderer supplied-state differential visual review; three candidate4 production entry screenshots. Synthetic HUD rectangles, not production HUD rendering, are clearly marked in supplied-state images.
findings: The front crystal fades around the raised actor; helmet, torso, tool and feet remain visible. Both native state-pair layers share one .22 combined opacity, with no additional opaque overlay.

Real offscreen attack produces one arrow at every requested viewport, clear of all measured HUD rectangles. Chosen arrow direction uses its actual position to the true offscreen node. Static infected ownership produces no arrow.

Healthy mint tissue branches, infected broken veins, actual directional 25→65% capture, and 25→70% purification expansion remain distinct in standard and low effects. Front nodes carry no healing cross.
Source membrane is present with an infected healing supplier even while front is healthy; it disappears after both are healthy.

Paused world caption is short with actual 70% progress. At 667 the renderer relocates it to the lower edge to avoid measured HUD; the screenshot-only DERIVED footer partly covers its bottom line. Production has no such harness footer. Full pause reason remains a production-HUD responsibility, covered separately by real input E2E.
Candidate4 real 667 entry shows both lanes, one objective and no false 0% purification.
limitations: No performance, physical-device, new-player completion-time or full-rescue claim from this fixture. Root owns those separate evidence sets.
Supplied-state fixtures freeze the real 2400x1500 world but are not proof of natural reachability.
Full native input-driven guard/victory and source-shield proofs belong to separate root verifier reports.

visualAcceptanceScope: Candidate4 render fixes and controlled state readability only; no overall product, performance, physical phone or natural full-run acceptance.
